about: Golden cases for the matching engine (stage 1.7). Facts only, copied from the research of 2026-10-25 (YouTube Music search pages, MusicBrainz, Deezer and Spotify metadata/4 facts, YouTube descriptions); every case names its provenance. Items with x- IDs are constructed.

Labels: exact = the source recording (any release, a remaster counts); equivalent = the same audio in another form (an official audio upload or a re-upload, a video); wrong = another recording, version, song or artist; unknown = not established. An Auto pick must be exact or equivalent; unlabeled items count as unknown.

Items: kind follows musicVideoType (ATV song, OMV music-video, else video); source "yt" marks regular YouTube results; durations are whole seconds as YouTube shows them; explicit is false for songs without the badge.
